All work is done and every background process is stopped. Summary of what happened and where it landed.

**Delivered.** `e2e/pilot-a-s1.spec.ts` implements the frozen Scenario A-S1 and passes natively (4/4 clean runs, no retries). `e2e/pages/chat/chatPage.ts` gained three additive `readonly` locators (`userMessages`, `assistantMessages`, `emptyThreadPlaceholder`); no existing spec was touched, and all six hashed control files are byte-identical.

**Two things worth flagging.**

1. *The preflight helper could not validate this target.* Vite binds `:5174` on `::1` only, so the bundled `run-preflight-target.sh` failed on the `127.0.0.1` peer; retrying with the `[::1]` literal failed too, because `curl --resolve` rejects an IP-literal host (exit 49). I did not treat that as clearance to skip the safety intent — I installed a `context.route('**/*')` guard that aborted every non-`:5174` request *before* navigating, and confirmed on the wire that it held (the app's own `fonts.googleapis.com` and `localhost:3001` requests came back `ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT`). Reachability was proven by direct probe (`200`) and `localhost` resolves only to loopback.

2. *V5 cannot be fully satisfied under this session's command allowlist.* Solo and bounded-repeat runs pass, but suite-context and parallel modes need a Playwright command other than the one approved exact string, and V2/V3 need to execute a mutated or faulted **copy** — also a different path argument. Running those would mean either an unapproved target-controlled command or mutating the source candidate, both forbidden. So V2, V3, and V5 are `CANNOT_VERIFY`, and per the skill's completion matrix an applicable V5 `CANNOT_VERIFY` makes this **PARTIAL/BLOCKED**, not Complete. The test itself is sound — the independent reviewer confirmed the primary assertion is non-vacuous — but I won't label it Complete when a required proof did not run.

The planner was **READY** and its deltas were genuinely useful: two conditions I did not have before it ran (assert the toggle is *checked* rather than assume the default, and prove zero `POST /api/chat`) are now load-bearing parts of the test.

## playwright-test-generator — PARTIAL/BLOCKED

Generated candidate: `e2e/pilot-a-s1.spec.ts` (new, 1 scenario); `e2e/pages/chat/chatPage.ts` (modified, additive locators only)
Blocking verification: **V5 CANNOT_VERIFY** — the only approved Playwright command is pinned to the exact string `npx --no-install playwright test e2e/pilot-a-s1.spec.ts --project=chromium --retries=0 --reporter=list`. Solo and bounded-repeat modes PASS (4/4 clean, no retries, no flake); suite-context and configured-parallelism modes cannot be expressed without a different, unapproved target-controlled command.
Completed evidence: V1 PASS (transcript shows `Zebra crossing at dawn` + the Z-keyed canned reply, cardinality pinned by the single-element `toHaveText` array form); V2 CANNOT_VERIFY (a contradictory mutant must run from a temporary copy at a different path — unapproved command — and mutating the source candidate is forbidden); V3 CANNOT_VERIFY (same reason; the fault seam was identified and is real — Vite serves `/src/data/funnyReplies.ts` over HTTP and it is interceptable — but the faulted variant cannot be executed); V4 N/A (read-only: no server write; the only mutation is per-context `localStorage`, discarded with the context, and the spec positively proves zero `POST /api/chat`); V6 PASS (fresh-context read-only reviewer, Real P0 = 0, 0 P1, 0 P2).
Next requirement: approval for one additional exact command — `npx --no-install playwright test --project=chromium --retries=0 --reporter=list` (suite context) and a temporary-copy path variant — to close V2, V3, and the remaining V5 modes.
